description: Managed environment variable contract for AI-Work-Infra. Defines variable metadata, scope, sensitivity, and consumer relationships.

variables.name: CTX7_API_KEY
variables.description: API key for Context7 MCP service. Used for documentation retrieval.

variables.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.description: GitHub personal access token for MCP integration.

variables.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
variables.description: GitLab personal access token for MCP integration.

variables.name: ORACLE_USER
variables.description: Oracle database username for profile-scoped connection.

variables.name: ORACLE_PASSWORD
variables.description: Oracle database password for profile-scoped connection.

variables.name: ORACLE_CONNECTION_STRING
variables.description: Oracle connection string (host:port/service) for profile-scoped connection.

variables.name: ORACLE_CLIENT_DIR
variables.description: Path to Oracle client libraries for thick mode. Not required for thin mode.

variables.name: ORACLE_MODE
variables.description: Oracle driver mode: thin or thick.

variables.name: ORACLE_MAX_ROWS
variables.description: Maximum rows returned by oracle_read. Hard ceiling: 10000.

variables.name: ORACLE_SCHEMA_ALLOWLIST
variables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed schemas (e.g., APP,REPORTING).

scope_definitions.GLOBAL: Shared across all profiles and sessions. Loaded from root .env.
scope_definitions.PROFILE: Job/profile-specific. Loaded from runtime/local-state/env/<profile>.env. Overrides GLOBAL for same-named variables.

sensitivity_definitions.SECRET: Must never be printed in diagnostic output or logs.
sensitivity_definitions.CREDENTIAL_PATH: Path to a credential file. Value is a filesystem path, not a secret itself.
sensitivity_definitions.NON_SECRET_CONFIG: Non-sensitive configuration value. May be printed in diagnostic output.
